_doc: Planks: sawn at the sawmill from wood (logs). Grain: reaped at a farm; flour: milled from grain; bread: baked from flour, and what the town eats (#99). Coal, iron ore and gold ore: dug at the mines (#42). Iron: smelted from iron ore and coal; tools: forged from iron and planks, what every trade works with (#102). Gold (smelted from gold ore) is the game's own. Wood, stone and food are the game's own.
